description: SANDBOX ONLY. Simulate a stablecoin deposit into your balance wallet on a network. The sender defaults to your first allowed (whitelisted) wallet, so a plain call credits the balance; an unknown sender is held for review, as it would be in production. Fails on production.

amount.description: Amount in major units, e.g. '250' or '250.5' (at most 6 decimals)

senderAddress.description: On-chain sender. Defaults to your first allowed wallet on the network

name: simulate_balance_deposit
title: Simulate balance deposit (sandbox)
